pages.text: The Lover's Cream that drops upon a $(l:offsprings/lover)$(c)$(o)Lover's$() death is quite the powerful substance. It can be used as is on creatures that can be impregnated to convert them; just like a Lover would. It can also be used as a melding agent in the $(l:equipment/eternal_youth)$(c)$(o)Eternal Youth$(), or mixed with Rose Petals to create a $(l:materials/purifying_paste)$(c)$(o)Purifying Paste$().
